items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I got my inspiration to pick up the trunk through Bunk's playing, see.

ctx.x: Did you say you heard Bunk over there?

Oh Bunk, Bunk and so on. I got my inspiration to pick up the trunk through Bunk's playing, see. Because I was a little kid when Bunk used to my home. We didn't wear no pants, they had those little long shapes on, you know. The boys, you know. And we used to go to the, see, go to the dance, you know. And he used to kid us, the way we used to ask my daddy for pop, you know, so cool. So I used to say, pop, give me a bottle of pop.
Oh did you remember Tommy Ladner over there?
